scope: Accept sampled feedback in this sparse scenario. No certification of continuous smoothness, touch response, dense-combat readability or phone FPS.

hitFlash.evidence: White player silhouette is clear at 0.1 and 0.2 seconds and normal again at 0.4; hull changes 35% to 27% with return prompt. Cyan ring does not hide the white flash.

impactRecognition.evidence: Small orange impact at 0.1/0.2 differs clearly from broad irregular orange/yellow fireball at 1 second. At 1.5 seconds residual sparks and smoke remain, with no fire at 2/3 seconds.
impactRecognition.weakness: Sparse sampling cannot resolve exact onset or transition continuity.

smokeFading.evidence: Curved smoke at 1.5 seconds records the turn; earlier portions thin/fade in later samples. No persistent opaque fire disk.
smokeFading.weakness: Gray granular smoke competes with mottled water and can be difficult to see.

wakeContinuity.evidence: Carrier and escort wakes stay attached to sterns as ships move across frames.
wakeContinuity.weakness: Repeated soft puffs still resemble a trail of beads rather than tapered foam.

cameraMotion.evidence: Initial catch-up leads to player held centrally through the turn while carrier exits upward and escort crosses below/right.
cameraMotion.weakness: Initial catch-up is noticeable; still samples cannot exclude between-frame jitter.

controlVisibility.evidence: HUD and right action buttons stay fixed, heat changes visibly, and large cyan circle keeps player location clear even when crossing the deck at 0.4–0.6.
controlVisibility.weakness: Circle resembles a persistent selection/shield annotation, is jagged in fallback, and does not isolate aircraft silhouette from deck. Ship passes under Bomb at 3 seconds; touch response untested.

altitude.evidence: Offset plane shadow and raised carrier island retain depth.
altitude.weakness: Dark ocean masks dark shadows. Large circle is a screen-space identity cue, not altitude information.

regressionsAndLimits: No new sampled motion failure observed.
Cyan player ring improves tracking but is visually prominent in quiet open water; fallback rasterization is coarse.
Shoreline changes from screenshot packet are not covered by this ocean-only motion sequence.
priorities: Preserve player localization while reducing persistent ring dominance in uncluttered scenes.
Improve smoke/water separation and taper wake foam.
Validate continuous motion and actual touch input separately.
